title: The Pulse of Mood Online: Unveiling Emotional Reactions in a Dynamic Social Media Landscape
reasoning: The paper explicitly focuses on 'Morality Detection' (Section 3.2), using transformer-based models to quantify moral sentiments along five dimensions: care/harm, fairness/cheating, loyalty/betrayal, authority/subversion, and purity/degradation. It benchmarks its morality detection method against Distributed Dictionary Representations (DDR) and evaluates its performance using F1-scores.
